card.name: Inside UDP-glucuronosyltransferase enzyme names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of the enzyme name UDP-glucuronosyltransferase or glycosyltransferase, such as 'os' and 'yl', where the word is still unfinished. It also fires weakly on a few other spots, like 'ethoxylated' and phrases about adding molecules.

modes.label: UGT enzyme name
modes.description: Partway through glucuronosyl- or glycosyl-transferase when UGT enzymes are listed in interaction text.

modes.label: Other chemistry or adding phrases
modes.description: Occasional hits on 'ethoxylated' or on a phrase about adding small molecules.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and unrelated, so the output effect is unclear, though some hint at catalysis and attaching.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the long enzyme name UDP-glucuronosyltransferase, as seen in drug interaction sections.
